summary: A disciplined session: deep upfront spec/test/data analysis with pre-computed expected values, a single architecture decision, near-linear implementation, and one well-diagnosed fix cycle to green. Verification went beyond the tests with per-page screenshots compared against all 16 references and re-running the full suite after the last edit. The blemishes are a shallow curl probe that let the one real bug through, a short stale-server loop, and never consulting the provided Hono skill/docs.
